dimensions.title: Correctness
dimensions.definition: Outputs match the expected values for valid inputs, including boundaries.
dimensions.question: Does the output equal what it should for every input in the cases, boundaries included?

dimensions.title: Consistency
dimensions.definition: The same input gives the same output across repeated runs, and the output follows the project's existing contracts (formats, error shapes, naming).
dimensions.question: Run it again, or next to the code around it: does it give the same answer, in the same shape?

dimensions.title: Latency
dimensions.definition: Time to result at stated percentiles under a stated load.
dimensions.question: How long does the output take to produce, under the load it will see?

dimensions.title: Memory consumption
dimensions.definition: Peak and steady-state memory for a stated input size, with no growth across repeated runs.
dimensions.question: How much memory does it need at the stated size, and does that stay flat when it runs again and again?

dimensions.title: Big O
dimensions.definition: The stated time and space complexity, backed by measurements at two or more input sizes.
dimensions.question: When the input grows, does the cost grow the way the plan says it does?

dimensions.title: Failure recovery
dimensions.definition: Behaviour when a dependency is down, slow or returns errors: retries, fallbacks, no partial writes, and recovery once it is back.
dimensions.question: When something it depends on fails, does it degrade as designed and come back cleanly?

dimensions.title: Exception handling
dimensions.definition: Invalid input and internal errors produce defined errors; nothing is swallowed, and no stack trace or secret leaks.
dimensions.question: When given bad input or hitting an internal error, does it fail in the defined way and only that way?

dimensions.title: Results
dimensions.definition: The task's expected behaviour and scenarios hold end to end in the real app.
dimensions.question: Used for real, end to end, does it do what the task promised?

dimensions.title: Task-specific KPIs
dimensions.definition: The category's own KPIs: hit ratio, query plan, numeric precision, accessibility and the like.
dimensions.question: Does it meet the measures that matter for this kind of work in particular?
